reason: I have a spare Mac mini, so I'd try the free self-hosted version before paying $99 a month. And a pre-alpha built by one developer running agents unattended on our paid quotas overnight is exactly the setup I fear will loop and burn tokens.
objection: A failed or looping run eats our agent quota overnight and nobody notices until the bill or the rate limit hits. I see nothing here about spend caps or kill switches.
would_change_my_mind: Hard per-run and per-night token or retry caps that stop a run and ping my phone, shown working on our own repo during the setup call.
